prompt: Challenge C022-CH3: We want to add a water-balance module so farmers can plan irrigation scheduling, but none of our staff understands evapotranspiration modell

content.text: {"expertise":[{"text":"Salt balance modelling has been implemented using the FAO-56 evapotranspiration method coupled with soil hydraulic parameters and validated against field data across contrasting soil types in Vojvodina.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-06706","field":"abstract","quote":"Monthly evapotranspiration (FAO-56 method), irrigation volumes from canal intake records, groundwater depth from 24 piezometers, and seasonal soil ECe profiles."}]},{"text":"Decision support models have been developed that integrate crop-specific parameters including crop tolerance thresholds with soil properties and field-measured data to predict water and solute dynamics in irrigated heavy clay soils.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-06710","field":"abstract","quote":"The model couples a three-layer salt balance routine with crop-specific salt tolerance thresholds (from FAO bulletin 29 values updated with local field data for sugar beet, sunflower, and wheat)"}]},{"text":"Experimental infrastructure exists for long-term monitoring of soil water and salt dynamics including time-domain reflectometry arrays and lysimeter networks on reference plots in the region.","sources":[{"id":"R0579","field":"bio","quote":"The laboratory operates a time-domain reflectometry array, a suction-cup lysimeter network on a 4-hectare experimental plot near Bečej"}]}],"fit":"strong","fitReason":"The researcher has directly implemented the FAO-56 evapotranspiration method in calibrated salt balance models [SYN-PUB-06706], coupled soil hydraulic properties with crop parameters in decision support tools [SYN-PUB-06710], and possesses validation datasets from Vojvodina irrigation seasons [SYN-PUB-06706], addressing all three core technical requirements for the water-balance module."}
